name: v1-cp3-glm-ocr-data-uri-fix
title: CP3.5-H 修正 GLM OCR data URI 请求格式
description: 修正 Python OCR 适配器传给 GLM layout_parsing 的 file 参数格式，从裸 base64 改为带 MIME 的 data URI，并补测试与验收证据。
creator: tianqingyuluo
notes: Completed. Added regression coverage and fixed GLM OCR `file` payloads to use MIME data URIs such as `data:image/jpeg;base64,...` and `data:application/pdf;base64,...`. 2026-05-27 real probe with `docs/参考资料/营业执照.jpg` confirmed `raw_base64 -> HTTP 400`, `data_uri -> HTTP 200`, and current `GlmOcrAdapter` returns `ocr_markdown`. 2026-05-27 full Java -> Worker -> GLM OCR -> result query run confirmed task `SW252E98F23D714BB6` reached `PARTIAL_SUCCESS`, reviewer result included `extractedFields[0].fieldKey=ocr_markdown`, and the OCR text contained `营业执照`, `统一社会信用代码`, and `91441303MA531L6K37`.
